name: io.github.invincible-jha/warrantor
description: Bounded authority for coding agents: irreversible actions staged for approval, not performed.

environmentVariables.name: AUMOS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: connected (default) shells out to the real trust-core and defstack binaries and reaches the running services; standalone returns deterministic stand-ins tagged source: "mock" so they can never be mistaken for enforcement.

environmentVariables.name: AUMOS_AGENT_IDENTITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a running agent-identity service. Only needed in connected mode; unset, identity tools report the missing dependency by name rather than failing silently.

environmentVariables.name: AUMOS_TRUST_CORE_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Path to the trust-core binary used by the sign and verify tools. Defaults to trust-core on PATH.
